registros.pergunta: Qual foi o campeão com a maior taxa de banimento em 2026?

resultados.sql:
SELECT c.champion_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id)::float / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matches) AS ban_rate
FROM bans b
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT champion_id, champion_name FROM participants) c
  ON c.champion_id = b.champion_id
JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
WHERE m.game_version LIKE '14.%'
GROUP BY c.champion_name
ORDER BY ban_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

registros.pergunta: Qual foi o jogador com maior média de CS por minuto na posição ADC?

resultados.sql:

registros.pergunta: Quais jogadores tiveram uma taxa de vitória superior a 70% em 2026, considerando pelo menos 20 partidas?

FROM pro_players pp
JOIN pro_games pg ON pg.game_id = pp.game_id AND pg.side = pp.side
WHERE pg.year = 2026
GROUP BY pp.player_name

registros.pergunta: Qual equipe apresentou a maior sequência de derrotas consecutivas?

resultados.sql:
WITH team_results AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_id,
    m.game_creation,
    t.win,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.team_id ORDER BY m.game_creation) AS rn,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.team_id, t.win ORDER BY m.game_creation) AS win_group
  FROM teams t
  JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = t.match_id
),
loss_sequences AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    win_group,
    COUNT(*) AS consecutive_losses
  FROM team_results
  WHERE win = false
  GROUP BY team_id, win_group
)
SELECT 
  team_id,
  MAX(consecutive_losses) AS max_consecutive_losses
FROM loss_sequences
GROUP BY team_id
ORDER BY max_consecutive_losses DESC
LIMIT 1;

Qual foi a porcentagem de partidas em que a equipe vencedora conquistou o primeiro sangue?

resultados.sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t.win THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS first_blood_rate
FROM teams t
WHERE t.win = true
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM participants p
    WHERE p.match_id = t.match_id
      AND p.team_id = t.team_id
      AND p.kills > 0
  );
